Reviewing commit 7c488b9eea47cd642128fb0d0b38618083c2693d against the three targeted corrections and prior P0-P2 areas.

**(1) AsyncInit concrete wrapper.** `AsyncInit<T>` is a concrete struct with `Mutex<AsyncInitState<T>>`, `Notify`, clock, cancel token, and `Arc<AsyncInitializer<T>>`. The accessor returns `Arc<T>` and clones on `Ready(Ok)`. State machine and Arc accessor match. ✓

**(2) Capability matrix closed tagged union.** `capabilities.v1.json` is a closed tagged union with exactly two variants: `kind: field` (field_id, owner, authoring/correction phases, provenance, invalidates, audit schema, command, owner_issue, test_ids) and `kind: outcome` (outcome_code, producing_phases, authorization_schema, command, target_phase XOR no_transition_exit_class, invalidates, audit schema, owner_issue, test_ids). Every disposition is encodable; duplicate/unknown/missing fields fail CI. ✓

**(3) PartOf checkpoint_completed transition.** `finish` applies `checkpoint_completed` from `published|merge_ready` back to `implemented`, clears review/publication/readiness/terminal fields, retains checkpoint receipt and normalized PR/linkage evidence, appends audit event. Capability matrix carries the outcome row with `authorization_schema: null`, target `implemented`, exact invalidations, and repeated-cycle tests. V3-15 acceptance criteria confirm the multiple-checkpoint journey. ✓

No regressions detected in prior approved P0-P2 areas (transaction commit-point semantics, AsyncInitState transition table, cancellation/exit-130 coverage, publication linkage disjointness, or cleanup canonical-path predicate).

DECISION: PASS
